chunks: Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام was asked about one who performs the Salat of Jaʿfar: would there be written for him, of reward, the like of what the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to Jaʿfar?

key_terms.إِي وَاللَّهِ: an emphatic affirmation meaning: yes, by Allah
key_terms.الْأَجْرِ: the divine reward for the act of worship
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.صَلَاةَ جَعْفَرٍ: the special prayer attributed to Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib

ai.seo_question: Does a person who performs the Salat of Jaʿfar receive the same reward mentioned by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله for Jaʿfar?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the one who performs the Salat of Jaʿfar receives the reward mentioned by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله for Jaʿfar. It highlights the merit and spiritual reward of this well-known devotional prayer in the Shia tradition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1537 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about someone who performs the Salat of Ja'far. Would they receive the same reward as that which the Messenger of Allah (sw) mentioned to Ja'far?
